fields.scope: Where do you want to work?
fields.goalsHelp: What would your organization like to achieve with the boxing community?
fields.title: Title
fields.titleHelp: A short name your team will recognise.
fields.summary: What would you like to explore?
fields.summaryHelp: Describe the partnership you have in mind. Don’t include prices, budgets or personal details of athletes or gym members.

fields.invalidChoice: Choose one of the options shown.
fields.notRequested: SimpleFit didn’t ask for changes to this answer.

errors.invalid: Some answers need attention. Nothing was saved.
errors.stale: Someone in your organization changed this in the meantime. Nothing was saved. Load the latest version and try again.
errors.readOnly: This organization is read-only right now. Nothing was saved.
errors.moved: This request’s status changed in the meantime, so this action isn’t available any more. Nothing was changed.
errors.openLimit: Your organization has reached the limit of open requests. Withdraw or finish one before starting another.
errors.reused: This attempt can’t be repeated. Try again.
errors.conflict: This couldn’t be done right now. Nothing was changed.
errors.forbidden: Your role doesn’t allow this. Ask an owner or a manager.
errors.gone: This isn’t available to you any more.
errors.session: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.rateLimitedFor: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.unconfirmed: We couldn’t confirm whether this went through. Trying again is safe: it won’t be done twice.

interests.title: Partnership interests
interests.lead: What your organization would like to do with SimpleFit now, and where. This helps SimpleFit understand you. It isn’t an offer or a commitment, and no budget is asked.
interests.emptyEditable: Nothing saved yet. Add what your organization is interested in.
interests.readOnly: Owners and managers can change these while the organization is active.
interests.applicationLead: What your application said when it was submitted on {date}. It stays as it was sent.

opportunities.title: Sponsorship opportunities
opportunities.noneBody: SimpleFit doesn’t offer sponsorship opportunities yet, so none are shown.
opportunities.instead: You can still tell SimpleFit what you’re interested in, or send a partnership request.

requests.title: Partnership requests
requests.lead: Ideas your organization has sent to SimpleFit, or is preparing. A request is nonbinding: nothing is agreed, booked or paid by sending one.
requests.emptyBody: Start a request to tell SimpleFit about a partnership you’d like to explore.
requests.emptyReadOnly: Owners and managers of an active organization can start requests.
requests.moreFailed: More requests couldn’t be loaded. Try again.

new.title: New partnership request
new.nonbinding: A request is a nonbinding message to SimpleFit. It doesn’t reserve anything, create a campaign or commit anyone to pay.
new.readOnly: Only owners and managers of an active organization can start partnership requests.
new.formLead: It’s saved as a draft. You can check it and submit it on the next page.

commands.withdrawBody: SimpleFit won’t review it any more. This can’t be undone, but you can start a new request later.

detail.title: Partnership request
detail.missingBody: It doesn’t exist, or it isn’t one of this organization’s requests.

meaning.draft: Only your organization can see this draft. Submit it when it’s ready.
meaning.submitted: SimpleFit has your request. Nothing is agreed yet.
meaning.under_review: SimpleFit is looking at your request. Nothing is agreed yet.
meaning.changes_requested: SimpleFit asked for changes. Update the answers below and submit again.
meaning.accepted: SimpleFit will follow up with you about this request. Nothing is agreed, booked or paid.
meaning.declined: SimpleFit isn’t taking this request further. Nothing was agreed.
meaning.withdrawn: This request was withdrawn. SimpleFit won’t review it.
meaning.unknown: This request has a status this page doesn’t know yet. Nothing is assumed about it.

detail.createdByMember: Started by a member of your organization.
